title: Rally Worker component diagram
description: The Rally Worker: the high-score API, the public scores page and, for every other path, the static game. Scores are never trusted from the browser. Every game needs a sign-in: the page and the score API are for signed-in players.

components.name: Rally Worker
components.responsibility: Routes requests to the API, the scores page or the static assets.

components.name: API routes (index.ts)
components.responsibility: POST api/game issues a seed, POST api/score replays and records, GET api/scores lists the table; other paths go to the static assets.

components.name: Score helpers (scores.ts)
components.responsibility: Parses submissions, cleans names, and verifies a match by replaying it.

components.name: Scores page (scores-page.ts)
components.responsibility: The public table as a web page.

components.name: Site look (look.ts)
components.responsibility: icelander.net's page shell, with inline CSS and a strict Content-Security-Policy.

components.name: Engine
components.responsibility: The same engine the browser runs.

components.name: Name rules (src/name.ts)
components.responsibility: Cleans names the same way as the browser.

components.name: Sign-in (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: The shared library: reads the host's games_session cookie and asks the login service who it is (requireRole); a page without a sign-in goes to /auth/sign-in on this host.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in, and their games: roles (service binding ACCOUNTS).
